title: AgentTimelineListResult
description: The person's agent timeline (design 2026-11-07 §1): what the agent is doing now, what needs them, and the entries themselves, newest first. The Dock's filters live in the query (cursor, mode, needs_you); counts say how many entries a hidden filter would show, so a filter never hides without a count.

now.description: The step the agent is doing this moment, if any.

needs_you.description: Every approval or question from any mode, oldest first.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page, or null at the end.

counts.description: How many entries each mode has (and "needs_you"), so the Dock can show what a filter would hide.
